newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX continues record advance.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX continues record advance.

text.p: Austrian shares continued their advance on Wednesday and traders forecast the market would sustain early gains.
The ATX index, which has scored a new closing high for the past three days, seen in a 1,305-1,320 points range.
Bank Austria preferred remained under selling pressure after Vienna's ruling coalition agreed on Tuesday to sell controlling stake over six-year period.
* Nine shares up, 10 down, two unchanged.
* Top ATX gainer Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien, up 2.39 pct at 536.5 ATS.
* Leading ATX decliner Bank Austria preferred, down 1.15 percent at 431 ATS.
* June ATX future up five points at 1,316 points. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
